live_defects: D1 (blocks all live submissions): the store's insert-time execution-proof validator (lib/repositories/production/sqlite.ts:157) requires canonicalJson(quotePayload.capability) === canonicalJson(payload.capability). The worker re-discovers its own capability at submit time (lib/jobs/production/worker.ts ~line 59), so the execution payload embeds a receipt with a different observedAt than the quote-time receipt — canonical equality can NEVER hold for a live provider (two network discoveries). Reproduced live via a rollback-protected probe against fresh queued job 9965dc1b-34d8-4b7d-8523-9df8099b0bd0: reserveSubmission threw 'Provider execution proof does not match its quote, worker session, or capability'. Fake-provider tests never caught it because fake discoverCapabilities returns deterministic receipts. Fix direction: the execution proof must pin the QUOTE-TIME capability (the evidence the quote was authorized against); the worker's own fresh discovery remains a fail-fast admission gate in worker.ts (expiry + canSatisfy) and the provider submit keeps its own live_catalog/expiry gate — the proof chain just stops re-embedding a second, necessarily-different receipt.

D2 (read-model 500): app/api/production/jobs/[id]/route.ts parses store events with strict JobEventSchema, but listJobEvents returns rows including an extra `jobId` key -> zod unrecognized_keys -> every job poll with >=1 event returns bare HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. Reproduced live (requestIds d77d64b0, 033dfceb; sqlite row inspection confirmed the extra key).

A-execution-proof-pins-quote-capability.change: In `reserveSubmission`: the execution payload must embed the QUOTE payload's capability (`quotePayload.capability`, already parsed a few lines above) instead of the worker-passed `capability` parameter; the `expiresAt` min bound and the null-expiresAt guard switch to `quotePayload.capability.expiresAt`. The worker-passed capability parameter stays in the signature (the durable-chain guard message may still reference it) but must NOT be embedded in the proof. Add a brief comment: the reservation pins the quote's authorized evidence; the worker's own discovery remains the admission/submit gate. Do NOT touch the sqlite validator, worker.ts, or provider files.
tests: RED first: extend the fake provider so a SECOND discoverCapabilities call returns a receipt with a different observedAt (simulating the worker's separate live discovery). Drive the existing worker-admission-shaped test path (prepareWorkerBudgetContext -> reserveSubmission with the second receipt) — under current code it must fail with the sqlite insert error 'Provider execution proof does not match its quote, worker session, or capability' (record RED); after the fix the reservation commits with the QUOTE-time capability embedded in the execution proof (assert via the stored execution proof payload's capability canonical equality to the quote payload's capability).
